answer: Cost to attacker: 0.5 ETH burned per identity plus ~10 GPU-hours mining a hash below the epoch seed before any peer attests its first trade. Burned, unrecoverable stake keyed to the seed makes every fake agent a sunk cost, so mass-sybil voting stops being a free script and becomes a capital purchase. Admission is scarce like saffron priced per stigma: only agents that climbed the summit get attested, and unpaid weeds never root in the vine.
